podcast.body: Released in 1999, this album is credited with inaugurating the French underground experimental electronica scene. Mr. Oizo's work on the album, especially his equalization and time-marking with scratching, was considered incredibly wild and innovative. "en 1999 se acaba analo-guon-s-attaque, un disco que es la leche yo creo que era uno de los tíos que inauguraba la estena underground experimental electrónica francesa de la que luego vendría toda la agenación de Vanguard Records."
